introHtml: Hand wash only decanters are crafted from premium materials like crystal or hand-blown glass that require gentle care to maintain their brilliance. Ideal for executive gifts or upscale event favors, these decanters offer a sophisticated canvas for your logo through etching or debossing. Choose hand wash only when you want a vessel that feels substantial and looks elegant, not a dishwasher-safe alternative.
